answer: Call a surprise roll call. At a random moment every identity gets a fresh puzzle due in 20 seconds, all at once. One honest agent answers easily; a farm running 500 keys on one rack must do 500 inferences together, and misses get frozen. Hidden scale shows like footprints on a dune after the wind dies. Estimate, assuming ~2s per inference on one GPU: a box covers about 10 keys, so copper-cheap clones become real hardware bills. Tradeoff: slow honest links miss too, so a miss costs only that epoch's pay, and the jade "verified" mark returns after the next clean call.
